hook: STAT3 keeps IL-6 from switching on a hidden STAT1 interferon program in human macrophages.
summary: IL-6 drives both healthy and inflammatory macrophage responses through STAT3, and how it picks between them was unclear. Epigenomic profiling plus targeted STAT3 degradation showed STAT3 scales chromatin changes and blocks STAT1 from taking over regulatory regions. Severe COVID-19 monocytes show a similar imbalance, but that link is correlational and from cultured cells.
title: STAT3 controls IL-6-induced epigenomic remodeling and restrains a latent STAT1-associated interferon program in human macrophages.
